questionText:
Tourist: "Excuse me, could you tell me the way to the nearest bank?"

Local resident: "_____"

choices.label: A
choices.text: Go straight ahead for two blocks, then turn left. It is on your right.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Yes, I like banks very much.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The bank opens at 8 a.m. every weekday.

choices.label: D
choices.text: No problem, you can take my money.

hint: Khách du lịch hỏi đường tới ngân hàng gần nhất ("could you tell me the way to..."). Câu trả lời cần chỉ dẫn hướng đi cụ thể.
explanation: Đáp án A là lời chỉ đường chuẩn xác: "Go straight ahead for two blocks, then turn left. It is on your right." (Đi thẳng hai dãy nhà, sau đó rẽ trái. Ngân hàng nằm ở bên tay phải bạn).

questionText:
A stranger: "Excuse me, is there a post office near here?"

Passer-by: "_____"

choices.label: A
choices.text: I am posting a letter right now.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Yes, it is just around the corner, next to the bookstore.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Letters are very expensive nowadays.

choices.label: D
choices.text: No, you cannot send emails there.

hint: Người lạ hỏi liệu có bưu điện nào gần đây không ("is there a post office near here?").
explanation: Đáp án B chỉ vị trí bưu điện một cách tự nhiên và chính xác: "Yes, it is just around the corner, next to the bookstore." (Có, nó ngay góc phố, cạnh hiệu sách).

questionText:
Visitor: "Can you show me how to get to the railway station?"

Police officer: "_____"

choices.label: A
choices.text: The train ticket is very cheap.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Trains usually depart on time.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Keep going until you see a roundabout, and it is on your right.

choices.label: D
choices.text: I am not traveling by train today.

hint: Cảnh sát cần đưa ra lời chỉ dẫn đường đi tới nhà ga.
explanation: Đáp án C đưa ra chỉ dẫn giao thông rõ ràng: "Keep going until you see a roundabout, and it is on your right." (Cứ đi tiếp cho đến khi bạn thấy vòng xuyến, nhà ga ở bên tay phải bạn).

questionText:
Sarah: "How far is it from here to the national museum?"

Tom: "_____"

choices.label: A
choices.text: It is about a ten-minute walk.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The museum has ancient artifacts.

choices.label: C
choices.text: It costs 50,000 VND to enter.

choices.label: D
choices.text: I visited the museum last Sunday.

hint: Câu hỏi "How far is it...?" hỏi về khoảng cách / thời gian di chuyển.
explanation: Đáp án A trả lời khoảng cách bằng thời gian đi bộ: "It is about a ten-minute walk." (Khoảng 10 phút đi bộ).

questionText:
Tourist: "Excuse me, where is the nearest bus stop?"

Girl: "_____"

choices.label: A
choices.text: Buses are often crowded at rush hour.

choices.label: B
choices.text: It is opposite the supermarket over there.

choices.label: C
choices.text: You should buy a monthly pass.

choices.label: D
choices.text: I am waiting for my sister.

hint: Hỏi vị trí của trạm dừng xe buýt gần nhất ("where is the nearest bus stop?").
explanation: Đáp án B chỉ vị trí đối diện siêu thị: "It is opposite the supermarket over there." (Nó nằm đối diện siêu thị ở đằng kia).

questionText:
David: "Which bus goes to the city center from here?"

Officer: "_____"

choices.label: A
choices.text: Bus number 09 will take you straight there.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The city center is very lively at night.

choices.label: C
choices.text: You can walk there in three hours.

choices.label: D
choices.text: No buses run on rainy days.

hint: Hỏi tuyến xe buýt đi đến trung tâm thành phố ("Which bus goes to...?").
explanation: Đáp án A đưa ra tuyến xe buýt số 09 đi thẳng tới đó.

questionText:
Driver: "Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to the general hospital?"

Pedestrian: "_____"

choices.label: A
choices.text: Doctors and nurses work very hard.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Drive straight on and take the second turning on your right.

choices.label: C
choices.text: I hope you will feel better soon.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Hospitals are strictly sanitized.

hint: Chỉ đường lái xe tới bệnh viện.
explanation: Đáp án B chỉ dẫn: "Drive straight on and take the second turning on your right." (Lái xe thẳng và rẽ ở ngã rẽ thứ hai bên tay phải bạn).

questionText:
Driver: "Excuse me, am I on the right road to Noi Bai airport?"

Toll worker: "_____"

choices.label: A
choices.text: Yes, just keep following this highway for 15 kilometers.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Airplanes fly at high altitudes.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Have a great flight next week.

choices.label: D
choices.text: You should bring your passport.

hint: Hỏi xem có đang đi đúng đường tới sân bay hay không.
explanation: Đáp án A xác nhận đúng đường và hướng dẫn tiếp tục theo đường cao tốc.

choices.label: A
choices.text: No, it is within walking distance, just 5 minutes away.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Yes, they sell fresh fruits and vegetables.

choices.label: C
choices.text: I often go shopping at weekends.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The parking lot is completely free.

hint: Hỏi về khoảng cách ("Is the supermarket far from here?").
explanation: Đáp án A: "No, it is within walking distance, just 5 minutes away." (Không, nó ở cự ly đi bộ được, chỉ cách đây 5 phút).

questionText:
Customer: "Excuse me, where can I catch a taxi?"

Hotel receptionist: "_____"

choices.label: A
choices.text: There is a taxi rank right outside the main hotel entrance.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Taxi drivers are usually friendly.

choices.label: C
choices.text: You should book a room in advance.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Traffic jams are terrible in the morning.

hint: Hỏi nơi bắt taxi ("where can I catch a taxi?").
explanation: Đáp án A chỉ rõ bãi đón taxi: "There is a taxi rank right outside the main hotel entrance."

questionText:
Tourist: "Could you direct me to the art gallery, please?"

Guide: "_____"

choices.label: A
choices.text: Go along this street until you reach the traffic lights, then cross over.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Oil paintings are my favorite form of art.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The artist graduated from university.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Taking photos inside is strictly prohibited.

hint: Yêu cầu chỉ đường đến phòng trưng bày nghệ thuật.
explanation: Đáp án A chỉ đường rõ ràng với điểm mốc là đèn giao thông.

questionText:
Old lady: "Excuse me, son. Do you know where the pharmacy is?"

Young man: "_____"

choices.label: A
choices.text: Walk past the bakery and you will see it next to the clinic.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Medicine is very good for your health.

choices.label: C
choices.text: I am studying to become a pharmacist.

choices.label: D
choices.text: You need a doctor prescription.

hint: Bà cụ hỏi vị trí hiệu thuốc.
explanation: Đáp án A chỉ dẫn: "Walk past the bakery and you will see it next to the clinic." (Đi qua tiệm bánh và bác sẽ thấy nó cạnh phòng khám).

questionText:
Tourist: "How long does it take to walk from here to the Old Quarter?"

Local: "_____"

choices.label: A
choices.text: It takes roughly 15 minutes at a normal pace.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The Old Quarter has 36 ancient guild streets.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Street food is very delicious there.

choices.label: D
choices.text: You should buy some souvenirs.

hint: Hỏi mất bao lâu để đi bộ đến Phố Cổ ("How long does it take to walk...?").
explanation: Đáp án A nêu thời gian: "It takes roughly 15 minutes at a normal pace." (Mất khoảng 15 phút đi bộ bình thường).

questionText:
Student: "Excuse me, is the city library near the botanical park?"

Librarian: "_____"

choices.label: A
choices.text: Yes, it is right between the park and the history museum.

choices.label: B
choices.text: You can borrow up to three books at a time.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Trees provide shade and clean air.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Please keep quiet in the reading room.

hint: Hỏi thư viện thành phố có ở gần công viên không.
explanation: Đáp án A chỉ rõ vị trí ở giữa công viên và bảo tàng lịch sử.

questionText:
Passenger: "Excuse me, could you tell me where gate number 3 is?"

Airport staff: "_____"

choices.label: A
choices.text: Go straight down this corridor and it is the second door on your left.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Flight VN210 will depart in twenty minutes.

choices.label: C
choices.text: You have two pieces of hand luggage.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Please fasten your seat belt.

hint: Hành khách hỏi cửa ra máy bay số 3 ở đâu.
explanation: Đáp án A chỉ dẫn đường đi trong sảnh sân bay: "Go straight down this corridor and it is the second door on your left."
